title: RS Context Neo — Regional Configuration
description: Defines the DEM source, hydrology parameters, and optional data layers for one regional deployment of RS Context Neo. Pair this profile with per-run flags (--aoi, --output, --force, --debug) on the command line.

$schema.description: URI reference to this schema. Used by editors for validation and auto-complete.

profile_name.description: Short human-readable name for this profile, e.g. 'US CONUS' or 'New Zealand'.

description.description: Longer description of this profile: region covered, data sources used, known limitations, etc.

parameters.title: Run Parameters
parameters.description: Operational parameters shared across all processing steps.

download_dir.description: Persistent cache directory for downloaded DEM files. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

scratch_dir.description: Temporary working directory for intermediate files. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

hydrology_threshold.description: Minimum upstream cell count to classify a cell as stream (units: cells).

hydrology_breach_dist.description: WhiteboxTools breach depression maximum distance (in cells).

taudem_cpu_cores.description: Number of CPU cores for TauDEM operations. null = all available cores.

oneOf.$comment: dem — DEM acquisition layer (TNM, WCS, or local file)
oneOf.title: DEM Layer

source.description: 'tnm' — USGS National Map 3DEP tile API. 'wcs' — any OGC WCS 1.0.0 endpoint. 'file' — local file path.

aoi.description: Path to GeoJSON AOI file. Required when source is 'tnm' or 'wcs'. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

filepath.description: Path to a local DEM file. Required when source is 'file'. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

oneOf.$comment: s3tables — fetches a single vector layer from AWS S3 Tables via Athena
oneOf.title: S3Tables Layer

layer_id.description: Unique identifier for this layer within the project XML.

label.description: Human-readable layer name shown in the Riverscapes Viewer.

output_path.description: Output GeoPackage path relative to the project output folder.

layer_name.description: OGR layer name inside the output GeoPackage (e.g. 'roads' or 'rail').

athena_output.description: S3 path for Athena query results. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

s3tables_path.description: S3 Tables path in format '<catalog>/<namespace>/<table>'. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

oneOf.$comment: cog_clip — clips a remote Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF to the AOI
oneOf.title: COG Clip Layer

layer_id.description: Unique identifier for this layer within the project XML.

label.description: Human-readable layer name shown in the Riverscapes Viewer.

output_path.description: Output raster path relative to the project output folder, e.g. 'vegetation/evt.tif'.

url.description: URL or GDAL virtual path to the source raster. Use '/vsicurl/https://...' for HTTPS COGs, 's3://bucket/key' for S3 objects (the driver converts this to a presigned /vsicurl/ URL automatically), or a plain local path. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

band.description: Raster band to extract. Defaults to band 1.

nodata.description: Nodata value to assign in the output raster. null uses the source raster's nodata value.

oneOf.$comment: wfs — fetches vector features from an OGC WFS endpoint
oneOf.title: WFS Layer

layer_id.description: Unique identifier for this layer within the project XML.

label.description: Human-readable layer name shown in the Riverscapes Viewer.

output_path.description: Output GeoPackage path relative to the project output folder.

url.description: Base URL of the OGC WFS endpoint, without query parameters. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

typename.description: WFS feature type name (the TYPENAMES parameter). Obtain from the service's GetCapabilities response. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

layer_name.description: Name for the layer inside the output GeoPackage.

version.description: WFS protocol version. '2.0.0' is recommended; use '1.1.0' for older services.

oneOf.$comment: raster — clips a raster (local or S3 COG) to the project extent
oneOf.title: Raster Layer

input.description: Source raster: relative project path, absolute local path, or s3://bucket/key URI. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

output_path.description: Output path relative to project output folder. Defaults to 'input' if input is relative, or derived from the input URI basename otherwise.

oneOf.$comment: wcs_raster — fetches a raster from an OGC WCS endpoint
oneOf.title: WCS Raster Layer

layer_id.description: Unique identifier for this layer within the project XML.

label.description: Human-readable layer name shown in the Riverscapes Viewer.

output_path.description: Output raster path relative to the project output folder.

url.description: Base URL of the OGC WCS endpoint. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

coverage.description: WCS coverage identifier (layer name). Obtain from the service's GetCapabilities response. Supports {env:VAR} substitution.

layer_name.description: Key used to register this raster in the project XML, e.g. 'PRECIPITATION'.

metadata.title: Project Metadata Defaults
metadata.description: Key-value pairs added to the Riverscapes project XML as hidden metadata. Merged with (and overridden by) any --meta values passed on the command line. Supports {env:VAR} substitution in values.
